title: Asm Lens project configuration
description: Project settings for the Asm Lens extension. Overrides the asmLens.* VS Code settings for files in this folder and below.

mode.description: "remote": compile on Compiler Explorer (baseUrl); the file and its local headers are uploaded. "local": run "compiler" on this machine; nothing is uploaded.

compiler.description: Local mode: the C/C++ compiler command or path (GCC or Clang compatible), for example g++, clang++, C:/msys64/ucrt64/bin/g++.exe or ./tools/gcc/bin/g++ (relative to this file). Default g++.

compileCommands.description: Local mode: compile_commands.json database(s) of your build (any file name), relative to this file. Each file is compiled with the compiler and flags of its entry; a header uses the entry of a source file that includes it, else one in the nearest folder. Files without a usable entry use includePaths, defines and flags.

compilers.description: Compilers in order of preference. The first one for a language is the default; switch with 'Asm Lens: Select Compiler' or the status bar.

oneOf.description: Compiler Explorer compiler id, e.g. g152.

id.description: Compiler Explorer compiler id, e.g. g152, clang1910, r1990. Use 'Asm Lens: Select Compiler' > Browse to look ids up. In local mode any name works.

name.description: Label shown in the status bar and CodeLens.

flags.description: Flags for this compiler (replaces the top-level flags).

language.description: Use this compiler only for files of this language. Omit for C and C++. Compilers for other languages must say which one.

mode.description: Overrides the top-level mode for this compiler.

compiler.description: Local mode: command or path of the compiler (e.g. clang++-18, rustc, python3.12). With compile_commands.json it runs instead of each entry's compiler, with the entry's flags.

compileCommands.description: This compiler's own compile_commands.json database(s), relative to this file, in place of the top-level "compileCommands"; false: none (this compiler's flags, defines and includePaths apply).

entriesWith.description: When compile_commands.json lists a file more than once (a 32-bit and a 64-bit build, say): use only the entries with all of these flags, e.g. "-m32".

entriesWithout.description: Like entriesWith: use only the entries with none of these flags, e.g. "-m32" for a 64-bit build written without -m64.

flags.description: Default C/C++ compiler flags, used by compilers without their own flags. Default -O2 -masm=intel.

language.description: Force the language of C-family files. By default .c files are C and everything else C++.

includePaths.description: Folders searched for #include files, in order of priority. Relative paths are relative to the folder holding this file.

recursive.description: Also search every subfolder of this folder (at this priority).

buildFolders.description: Folder names searched last for headers found nowhere else (generated headers). Wildcards such as cmake-build-* work. Default: build, out, bin, cmake-build-*, generated, ...

excludePaths.description: Glob patterns of folders whose headers are never uploaded (added to the built-in list: libcxx, llvm-project, sysroot, node_modules, ...). A bare name like "vendor" means any folder with that name.

extraFlags.description: C/C++ flags added after the others.

uploadSystemHeaders.description: Remote mode: also upload workspace copies of standard headers (string, vector, stdio.h, ...). Off by default: the compiler's own headers are used.

baseUrl.description: Compiler Explorer instance URL (default https://godbolt.org). Point it at a self-hosted instance to keep code in-house.

maxIncludeFiles.description: Maximum number of header files uploaded per analysis (default 80).
